apps.name: Trainyard
apps.sentence: Trains an image classifier from your own webcam shots, entirely in the browser.
apps.signature_detail: Per-class confidence lamps that light as the live prediction shifts.
apps.paid_tier_hypothesis: More classes, more examples per class, and saved projects.
apps.notes: From approved idea #2. Audio deferred; the Embedder interface is the seam for it. Score provisional at 7 until tried on a real camera — the e2e fake camera shows one scene for both classes, so real-world accuracy is unverified.

apps.name: Cronlens
apps.sentence: Shows which cron runs a daylight-saving change skips or repeats, for a given expression and time zone.
apps.signature_detail: A 24-hour strip per clock change with the missing or doubled hour hatched and runs plotted on it.
apps.paid_tier_hypothesis: Check many crontabs at once, import a crontab file, and scheduler-specific behaviour notes.
apps.notes: Own idea, not from the inbox. Lighthouse not measured this run. Scheduler-specific behaviour deliberately not claimed.

apps.name: Budgeter
apps.sentence: Budgeter turns a UK annual salary into monthly take-home and shows what is left after recurring spending.

apps.name: Guitar Cam
apps.sentence: Guitar Cam helps a guitarist practising or working out a part see which note or chord they are playing, on which fret, in real time, and turn it into a tab they can export, without guessing by ear or retyping tab by hand.
apps.notes: Live note/chord detection, fretboard, tab; exports MusicXML, MIDI, ASCII tab, JSON (no native .gp).

apps.name: Huekeep
apps.sentence: Huekeep helps a designer or front-end developer whose brand colour fails WCAG contrast get the nearest passing colour, same hue, as a pasteable hex in under ten seconds, without nudging a picker until the ratio turns green.
apps.signature_detail: Lightness ribbon: the colour at every lightness with passing zones and was/now markers
apps.paid_tier_hypothesis: Whole-palette fixing, design-token export, APCA readout
apps.notes: OKLCH hue-held solver, 8-bit verified, WCAG 2.x only, no alpha; share links; offline service worker.

apps.name: AI Detector
apps.sentence: AI Detector helps a student checking their own work see which sentences read as AI-written in under a minute, without uploading private coursework to a server.
apps.signature_detail: Highlighter-pen sentence marks in three strengths

apps.name: Crumb Clock
apps.sentence: Crumb Clock helps a home sourdough baker work out when to feed, mix, shape and bake in under ten seconds, without doing the back-of-envelope maths and setting eight alarms by hand.
apps.signature_detail: Timeline rail whose night-time steps turn hollow red
apps.paid_tier_hypothesis: Multiple loaves, hydration calculator, recipe library
